name: Charlotte
tagline: Banking Capital of the South with Big-City Amenities and Southern Charm
description: Charlotte delivers a surprising amount of big-city polish at mid-tier prices. As the second-largest financial center in the US, it offers excellent infrastructure, a growing food and brewery scene, and easy access to both the Blue Ridge Mountains and Carolina beaches. North Carolina's moderate tax burden and affordable housing make it a practical FIRE destination for those who want urban convenience without coastal price tags.

quickFacts.visa: No visa required for US citizens
quickFacts.climate: Subtropical with hot humid summers and mild winters

housing.description: Cheapest-acceptable studio or older 1BR in a workable area — the University area, east Charlotte, or an outer Plaza Midwood/NoDa fringe

dining.description: Casual Southern spots and food trucks a few times a week; mostly cooking at home

healthcare.description: ACA marketplace Silver plan on the NC exchange, subsidized if MAGI is kept under the 2026 400%-FPL cliff (~$62,600 single); assumes an early retiree (45–55) — older retirees budget more

transportation.description: A paid-off used car with insurance; the LYNX light rail covers only the uptown corridor, so a car is needed for most errands

entertainment.description: Free festivals, greenway trails, brewery happy hours, Panthers watch parties

1M.lifestyle: A cheapest-acceptable studio or older one-bedroom in the University area or an outer Plaza Midwood fringe, cooking most meals at home with casual Southern spots and food trucks a few times a week. The LYNX light rail covers the uptown corridor, but a car is needed for most errands, and the ACA Silver premium stays low only if MAGI is managed under the 2026 ~$62,600 cliff. Charlotte's greenway trails and free festivals fill the calendar. A disciplined but workable big-city-South base.

housing.description: A decent 1BR in a solid area — South End, Dilworth, or a Ballantyne townhome

dining.description: Regular dinners at mid-range restaurants in South End; weekend brunch spots

healthcare.description: A Silver plan; net cost stays low only if MAGI is managed under the ~$62,600 cliff

transportation.description: A reliable mid-range car with full coverage; occasional LYNX use

entertainment.description: Hornets and Panthers games, brewery tours, a Whitewater Center membership, PNC concerts

2M.lifestyle: A comfortable one-bedroom in South End or Dilworth, eating out several times a week across the growing restaurant and brewery scene. Hornets and Panthers games, a US National Whitewater Center membership, and weekend trips to the Blue Ridge or the Carolina coast are all within budget. Charlotte offers solid urban amenities at prices well below the Northeast corridor.

housing.description: A high-quality 1BR or small place in a tree-lined historic area — Myers Park, Eastover, or an uptown condo

dining.description: Regular dining at top Charlotte tables like The Stanley, Haymaker, and Steak 48

healthcare.description: A Gold-tier plan (Atrium Health / Novant network); padded near the ~$62,600 ACA cliff where premium tax credits phase out

transportation.description: A late-model sedan or SUV, premium insurance, occasional rideshare

entertainment.description: Season tickets, a private golf membership, spa memberships, weekend mountain getaways

3M.lifestyle: A high-quality place in a tree-lined historic neighborhood like Myers Park or Eastover, or an uptown condo, dining regularly at Charlotte's top tables. Season tickets to the Panthers or Hornets, a private golf membership, and weekend trips to Asheville or the Outer Banks fit comfortably. Healthcare is a Gold plan padded near the ~$62,600 ACA cliff, and a late-model car covers mountain drives. A comfortable, affluent big-city-South life.

housing.description: A luxury home or penthouse condo — Quail Hollow, a SouthPark estate, or an uptown high-rise

dining.description: Fine dining several nights a week plus a private chef for dinner parties and wine-club memberships

healthcare.description: An unsubsidized Gold/Platinum plan plus a Novant or Atrium Health executive concierge program

transportation.description: A luxury vehicle, premium insurance, detailing service

entertainment.description: A country club membership, premium Panthers/Hornets seats, golf trips, cultural events

luxuryExtras.description: Quarterly luxury travel, Lake Norman boat weekends, premium wine, philanthropy

5M.lifestyle: A luxury home in Quail Hollow or SouthPark, or an uptown penthouse, with regular dining at the city's best restaurants and housekeeping several times a week. Concierge medicine through Novant or Atrium Health, a nice car, and business-class flights are standard. A country club membership, premium sporting seats, and Lake Norman boat weekends fit comfortably in the budget.

housing.description: An estate home in Myers Park or a lakefront property on Lake Norman

dining.description: A private chef, exclusive private dining, catered events and galas

healthcare.description: A top-tier unsubsidized concierge plan plus executive wellness — fully out of subsidy range

transportation.description: Multiple luxury vehicles, a dedicated driver, private car service

entertainment.description: A private box at Bank of America Stadium, art collecting, philanthropic galas, international travel

domesticHelp.description: Full-time housekeeper, personal assistant, and grounds/pool maintenance team

luxuryExtras.description: First-class international travel, a lake house, private event hosting, angel investing, charitable giving

10M.lifestyle: An estate home in Myers Park or a lakefront property on Lake Norman, full-time staff, a private chef several days a week, and a private box at Bank of America Stadium for Panthers games. Travel is first class, healthcare is top-tier concierge care, and Charlotte's role as a major financial center provides a social scene oriented around business and philanthropy. The city's affordable cost base means this budget — roughly $215k a year — covers everything without strain.
